sampling.method: Random selection without replacement from a deduplicated public-directory candidate pool, excluding the original100 usernames and repeated profile images.
sampling.location_basis: Explicit Modash creator profile.location == India; country/city audience labels alone were not accepted.
sampling.image_basis: Profile images served by the directory proxy; username/image associations checked against the source records.
sampling.image_processing: JPEG, maximum96px on longest side, quality60.
